trust_decision.summary: Whether parameter values taken from the param_query_<id>_{k=v} reference in a Query Results query may be spliced into another saved query's text and run on that query's data source: at the pinned commit get_query_results() substitutes them raw with only view_only access checked; the fix routes them through ParameterizedQuery schema validation and requires not_view_only when the query is not is_safe.

landing_point.why: The summary names Query Results parameterized substitution, and replace_query_parameters is the only raw str.replace of {{key}} in that runner; get_query_results calls it at :76.

fix_sites.entry_point: Executing a query on a 'Query Results' data source: POST /api/query_results (redash/handlers/query_results.py:143-188), POST /api/queries/<id>/results (redash/handlers/query_results.py:240-277), POST /api/queries/<id>/refresh (redash/handlers/queries.py:463-469), and scheduled refresh (redash/tasks/queries/maintenance.py:84-99), all via Results.run_query (redash/query_runner/query_results.py:168-176)
fix_sites.module_kind: query runner plugin (data-source driver), not an HTTP handler

fix_sites.entry_point: Same as above; the helper is removed (fix.diff:149-154) and replaced by ParameterizedQuery

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only redash/query_runner/query_results.py (fix.diff:131-176).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The gaps that remain sit inside ParameterizedQuery in redash/models/parameterized_query.py, which the HTTP handlers also use. A solver can argue that the model's notion of 'safe' and 'valid' is shared, existing behaviour (and a separate concern), and that the job is only to make Query Results reuse it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Users with view-only access to the inner query's data source must still be able to reference query_<id> and cached_query_<id>, and to pass safe-typed parameters (number, enum, query, date). Full-access users must still be able to pass text parameters. Requiring not_view_only for every reference, or rejecting all params, breaks this (and the fix's own test at fix.diff:251-264).

O6_input_shapes: k=v query-string pairs parsed with parse_qs, first value only (fix.diff:172-174)
declared params of safe types (number/enum/query/date/date-range), validated by schema (redash/models/parameterized_query.py:155-171)
declared 'text' params, gated by not_view_only via is_safe (redash/models/parameterized_query.py:184-187)

O7_producer.where: Parameter schema from query.options['parameters'] (redash/models/__init__.py:848-853), interpreted by ParameterizedQuery._valid/is_safe (redash/models/parameterized_query.py:135-187)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The inner query has undeclared {{placeholders}} and an empty parameters schema: is_safe is true and _valid returns True for any key, so the fixed path still renders raw values for a view-only user.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Empty schema means 'no parameters declared', and the HTTP handlers have the same behaviour, so it looks like a separate design issue (it was fixed under a separate advisory, GHSA-v5m6, in the same release per fix.diff:27).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (redash/models) from the landing point (redash/query_runner)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Declared 'text-pattern' params are not counted as unsafe by is_safe, which only checks type == 'text', so a view-only user passes any value matching the author's regex.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Text-pattern is regex-validated by _is_regex_pattern (redash/models/parameterized_query.py:92-99), so it looks 'validated'. It was also handled by a separate advisory (fix.diff:27).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (redash/models) from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Multi-value enum/query params: join_parameter_list_values builds prefix+value+suffix with the author's separator after validation. Through parse_qs value[0] this is a scalar, so it is not reachable here; recorded for completeness.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Values are restricted to the allow-list before joining.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second parameterized reference form (for example cached_param_query_<id>_{...}, or a JSON params form) whose own substitution helper skips ParameterizedQuery.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The runner already has three hand-written regex reference forms (:31-42), each with its own loop in create_tables_from_query_ids; adding a fourth with copied substitution is a natural maintainer move.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A get_query_result(query_id, params) variant in the Python runner's helpers that re-executes the saved query with params via str.replace.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The helper already loads saved queries by id with only view_only checks; adding parameter support mirrors what Query Results does, and it lives in a different runner file.

O9_family: SQL injection / authorization bypass via unvalidated template parameter substitution (CWE-89)

services: Redis (RQ; tests use it or a fake)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap the raw str.replace for ParameterizedQuery(...).apply() (the published fix) and trust is_safe/_valid, leaving empty-schema undeclared placeholders and text-pattern open for view-only users; or quote/escape the substituted string.
